paragraphs: Rav Ya'arkov [יערקב in the heading; apparently Yaakov] bar Abba, in Rava's time. In the first chapter of Eruvin (12b), he raised an objection against Rava. He visited Rava's house, and he said to him, etc.; Rava said to him, and he addressed Rava as 'master,' Arvei Pesaḥim (103, end of side a). Rava said to him, 'How many elders have erred!' Zevaḥim (70b). Accordingly it appears that there were two R. Yaakov bar Abbas: one, Rav's student, as She'erit Yosef lists him among Rav's students; and one who raised an objection against Rava. Or he was old and attended both; that is why Rava called him 'elder.'
